recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a five-member male group standing in a desert landscape against a backdrop of jagged rock formations under a bright, hazy sky, topped with a centered, rectangular typographic block.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark silhouettes of the band members contrast against the sun-bleached, tan desert floor.
The horizontal line of the rock formations bisects the image, separating the textured ground from the flat sky.
The geometric rigidity of the top text block balances the organic, irregular shapes of the natural landscape.
coreInvariants: Desaturated, warm color palette with high-key sky.
Subject eye levels roughly aligned in the lower half of the frame.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged horizontally across the lower 40% of the frame, varying in height and posture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A dark blue-grey rectangular box containing large, white sans-serif lettering at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold top text block down to the central figure's face, then scanning outward to the flanking band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive, bright sky in the upper third provides breathing room for the primary title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale cream and tan (sky and desert floor).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal (clothing and text block).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Denim blue and muted ochre (clothing and rock shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a 'faded film' look; high value in the sky creates a slight silhouette effect on the horizon.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide tracking for the subtitle text

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated from box by small margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and tracking settings for cohesion.
graphicDevices: Solid rectangular background container for primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric balance and clean uppercase presence.
Classic geometric proportions for the circular characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of five men in casual western-inspired clothing (denim, leather jackets, hats) standing in a desert with jagged brown rock formations behind them. The sky should be a bright, hazy off-white. Apply a vintage, desaturated film filter with warm shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a dark navy rectangle at the top center. Inside, typeset the main title in a bold white geometric sans-serif with wide tracking. Below the box, typeset the subtitle in a smaller, dark navy sans-serif with extremely wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text block centered horizontally?
Does the sky occupy at least the top 30% of the frame?
Is the color palette muted and warm?
Is the tracking on the subtitle significantly wider than the main title?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the sky.
Check that the horizon line doesn't cut through the subjects' heads awkwardly.
Verify the 'faded' look is consistent across the entire image.
Confirm the geometric sans-serif has no serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Desert Landscape + Horizontal Group Portrait + Top-Centered Geometric Typography Box = Modern Western Music Aesthetic.
